notes.title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith Patch 3!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Warriors of Gliese![/h3]

We're excited to bring you another update for Astor: Blade of the Monolith! This patch includes a variety of improvements based on your feedback and our ongoing efforts to enhance gameplay and balance.

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Weapon Balance:[/b] Balanced various weapons, with special attention to the Gauntlets and Hammer. Adjustments aim to improve effectiveness and ensure each weapon feels distinct and powerful.
[*] [b]Construct Companions Enhancement:[/b] Adjusted Construct Companions to hit harder and exhibit more aggressive behavior in combat.
[*] [b]Boss Balance Rework:[/b] Several bosses have been reworked to provide a more challenging experience, aligning their difficulty better with regular enemies.
[*] [b]Improved Block Responsiveness:[/b] The responsiveness of the block action has been enhanced, making parries more accurate and timing-dependent.
[*] [b]Boss Attack Fixes:[/b] Fixed issues where some boss attacks could be interrupted unexpectedly, causing behavioral inconsistencies.
[*] [b]Block Drop Construct Adjustments:[/b] Increased cooldown and adjusted damage values for the Block Drop construct. Now rewards skilled players with a 1.5x damage multiplier when used with a combo of 10 or higher.
[*] [b]Aerial Combat Adjustments:[/b] Melee enemies will no longer throw projectiles while the player is performing aerial attacks, eliminating unfair interruptions.
[/list]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Crystal Life Items:[/b] Added new crystal life items to the store:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Healing Crystal
[*] Health Crystal Boost Lv 1, Lv 2, and Lv 3
[/olist]
[list]
[*] [b]New Awakening Tutorial:[/b] Added a reinforced tutorial for the Awakening mechanic to provide clearer guidance and understanding for players.
[/list]

[h3]Audio and Visual Enhancements[/h3]
[b]Combat Music Intensity:[/b] Adjusted the intensity of combat music to change more gradually based on the number of hits performed in combat, providing a smoother and more natural transition.
[b]Golem King Boss Audio:[/b] Improved audio for the Golem King boss encounter for a more immersive experience.
[b]Collision Improvements:[/b] Enhanced tree collision mechanics to improve realism and gameplay interactions.

[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Challenge and Replay Fixes:[/b] Addressed various bugs related to challenges and replay functionality.
[*] [b]Renamed map tab[/b] in adventure menu to collectables to better reflect the purpose of this section
[*] 
[/list]
We're committed to delivering the best experience possible in Astor: Blade of the Monolith. 

Your feedback continues to be invaluable to us, so please keep sharing your thoughts and experiences!

Thank you for your support and dedication to exploring the world of Gliese with us.

[h3]— The C2 Game Studio Team
[/h3]

notes.title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith Patch 1.1.0 is out!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Warriors of Gliese![/h2]

[b]We are excited to bring you the second update for Astor: Blade of the Monolith![/b] Your feedback has been instrumental in helping us identify and fix issues, as well as improve the game. We hope you continue to share your thoughts with us as you explore the mysteries and dangers of Gliese.

[h2][b]Update 1.1.0 Patch Notes:[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/228be910c3af6b1a2e860f07e1c573bd69a68c0a.png[/img]
[b]Community Feedback Implementation[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Hammer Rune Ability: [/b]Adjusted the hammer's rune ability to be more effective and responsive, ensuring it hits enemies more reliably and faces their direction when activated.
[*] [b]Additional Controller Mapping Presets:[/b] Added 2 extra presets based on feedback.
[*] [b]Improved Drowning Mechanics:[/b] Falling into deep water no longer deals damage to the player, improving the drowning mechanic for a more seamless gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Enhanced Climbing Sequences:[/b] Improved climbing sequences, particularly in the Start Camp level, to provide smoother and more intuitive traversal mechanics.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cinematic Loops:[/b] Fixed an issue where the final cinematic sequence from Kalios to Lyceum could get stuck in an indefinite loop.
[*] [b]Respawn Glitches:[/b] Resolved a rare bug where falling into water would cause the player to respawn on top of the water instead of on solid ground.
[*] [b]Character Behavior:[/b] Corrected an issue where Zan would walk out of cinematic scenes in Start Camp. Zan will now stay in place as intended. (He's not that shy anymore). 
[*] [b]Low Health Warning:[/b] Improved the low health status effect to alert players earlier, giving more time to react and heal.
[*] [b]Collectable Items:[/b] Fixed the collectable item counting in levels, which previously showed incorrect totals on the map.
[*] [b]Chapter Replay Fix:[/b] Addressed an issue in the replay chapter of "Inside the Monolith" during the fight against Haken, ensuring the encounter progresses smoothly.
[*][b]Fixed the bug with the achievement: Ultimate Life Form not triggering properly at all times. [/b](Players that already bought all the upgrades can unlock it by opening a store and waiting for a few seconds)
[/list]
We are continuously working on implementing your suggestions and addressing other reported bugs. Your support and feedback are invaluable to us, and we encourage you to keep sharing your experiences as you journey through Gliese. If you can, please leave us a review - it really helps let others know about the game! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1989320/Astor_Blade_of_the_Monolith/#app_reviews_hash]You can leave a review here[/url]

From all of us at C2 Game Studio and TinyBuild, thank you for your continued support. We look forward to seeing you wield the Blade of the Monolith with newfound power and precision!

[b]— The C2 Game Studio Team[/b]

notes.title: Monolith: RotA Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/mCj4sPj/r54-Vc-LO-1536x864.jpg[/img]

[i]Our demo for Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients is live and ready for download until October 16th. We’re so excited to share it with you, and can’t wait to hear what you think![/i]

[b][h3]October 13th Patch Notes:[/h3][/b]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Input Remapping
[*] Camera Sensitivity Settings[/list]
[b]Localization In All Languages:[/b]
[list]
[*] Spanish – Latin America
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Portuguese – Brazil
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese[/list]
[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] General UI/HUD improvements
[*] Auto dash changes to manual dash with RT or Shift Keyboard[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now interact with a ‘Button’ to open the first ‘Gate’ before killing the enemies.
[*] ‘Zan’ no longer gets stuck on the stairs when investigating the room with ‘Astor’.
[*] All inputs will no longer be lost when interacting with the portrait while talking to ‘Zan’ in the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Purple Crystal’ will now respawn after loading an autosave where the player has already destroyed it at the ‘Temple of Soma’
[*] ‘Resolution Scale’ is now translated into some languages in the ‘Graphics’ menu.
[*] ‘Runic Shield’ tutorial can now be completed when reloading an autosave without finishing it at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] Enemies will now spawn when reloading a save file without killing them in the wing entrance at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Astor’ can now talk with ‘Zan’ in the portrait room when going there for the first time at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Crystal’ can now be interacted with when reloading an autosave in the end of the ‘Religion Wing’ at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Crystal’ can now be interacted with when reloading a manual save file after it is already activated in the ‘Main Chamber’ at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Pickup’ is now translated into any language besides ‘English’ when interacting with the ‘Shard Upgrade’.
[*] ‘Apply’ typo has been fixed in the ‘Graphics’ menu when the game’s language is set to ‘Portuguese’.[/list]

Wishlist Monolith: RotA today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1989320/Monolith_Requiem_of_the_Ancients/
